header.running_head: Enduring Hunger when Inviting People Towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

Hadhrat Aamir (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once sent us on a military expedition with only a bag of dates as provisions. The commander would (initially) distribute handfuls of it amongst us until he could give us only one each." His son asked, "Of what use is one date?" Hadhrat Aamir (RA) said, "Do not say that, dear son. We realised the value of the one date when we did not even have one date."[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) and his Companions Experience Severe Hunger on a Journey

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ appointed Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) as our commander and sent us to intercept a caravan of the Quraysh. Unable to find anything else, we took a bag of dates with us for our provisions. From there, Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) used to give us each a single date." The narrator asked Hadhrat Jaabir (RA), "What would you do with just a single date?" He replied, "We would suck on it as a child suckles and then drink water. This would meet our requirements for the day until the night. We also used our staffs to bring leaves down from the trees, which we soaked in water to eat." The Hadith continues.[^3]

A narration of Maalik, Bukhari, Muslim and others state that the Sahabah (RA) numbered three hundred on the expedition while a narration of Tabraani places the figure above six hundred.[^4] A narration of Imaam Maalik states that a student of Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) asked him, "Of what use was the one date?" He replied, "When all the dates were finished, we missed even that one date."
The Hunger Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) Suffered During the Tihaama Expedition

Hadhrat Abu Khunays Ghifaari (RA) narrates that he accompanied Rasulullaah ﷺ on the Tihaama expedition. When they reached Usfaan, the Sahabah (RA) approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! We are suffering extreme hunger. Permit us to eat one of the riding animals." Rasulullaah ﷺ granted the permission. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) was informed about this, he came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Nabi of Allaah ﷺ! What have you done? If you have instructed the people to slaughter their riding animals, what will they ride?" "What do you suggest, O son of Khattaab?" asked Rasulullaah ﷺ.
